title: Language Characterization by Step Checks
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $x,w,w'$ be Boolean lists and $s\in\mathbb{N}$. Pair-encode $x$, then $w$, then $w'$, then the binary expansion of $s$, using the self-delimiting pairing described above. This string belongs to the language of encoded bounded-space one-step transitions of $N$ if and only if the step-check predicate holds for $x,s,w,w'$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
